issuing_orgs: National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences
synopsis: The purpose of the High Impact Specialized Innovation Programs (SIPs) is to support the development and demonstration of unique hub capabilities, research platforms and/or resources to address in a timely manner critical gap areas and/or roadblocks in clinical and translational science at awarded UM1 Clinical and Translational Science Awards (CTSA) Program Hubs (PAR-24-272). Successful programs supported through this funding opportunity are expected to lay a strong foundation for future adoption and/or dissemination of capabilities to additional CTSA Program Hubs.
title: Limited Competition: High Impact Specialized Innovation Programs in Clinical and Translational Science  (RC2 Clinical Trials Optional)
